parameters.parameter_family: team count, active-roster size, scoring/PPR, rookie-draft rounds, lineup slots, FLEX/Superflex eligibility, K/DST support and playoff settings
parameters.source: Synced Sleeper data/league.json; league rules are resolved centrally by script/league_rules.py
parameters.validation: Current-FSFFL rule regression plus synthetic cross-league portability checks
parameters.update_policy: Update only when league/NFL rules change
parameters.notes: Projection formulas remain outside this refactor. The future-pick planning horizon is explicitly provisional runtime scope, not a league rule.

parameters.parameter_family: player scoring means and source weights
parameters.source: Current external projection source(s), recalculated under FSFFL scoring
parameters.validation: Required: rolling historical out-of-sample source/ensemble accuracy by position and horizon
parameters.uncertainty: Not yet demonstrated for projection mean layer
parameters.update_policy: Re-estimate source weights when new completed-season/week evidence is available; promote only on holdout improvement

parameters.source: Historical realized weekly scoring dispersion is used as a proxy for forecast uncertainty; position floors, shrinkage, Normal distribution shape, median offset and non-bye availability remain heuristic
parameters.validation: Required: archived forecast residual calibration/coverage tests by position and forecast horizon; realized-score dispersion alone is not forecast-error validation
parameters.uncertainty: Material: cross-player/outcome dispersion is not equivalent to conditional forecast residual variance
parameters.update_policy: Replace proxy dispersion with versioned residual-based estimates when archived forecasts exist; challenger must improve held-out distributional calibration

parameters.parameter_family: current production, future value, liquidity and resilience weights
parameters.source: Versioned data/gm/state_weight_calibration.json expert-prior artifact containing the legacy GM anchors; empirically_validated=false
parameters.validation: Required: real versioned training artifact plus temporal/holdout validation and sensitivity analysis
parameters.uncertainty: high until a historical training artifact demonstrates out-of-sample improvement over the expert prior
parameters.update_policy: Replace or promote the expert prior only with versioned calibration that improves appropriate holdout performance

parameters.source: Current hard-coded rank curve layered on external market values
parameters.validation: Required: FSFFL completed-trade residuals versus frozen contemporaneous market values, tested out of sample
parameters.uncertainty: risk of double counting scarcity/consolidation already embedded in the external market anchor
parameters.update_policy: Estimate residual league-specific curve only if stable predictive improvement is demonstrated

parameters.component: Market-tier scarcity versus roster replacement value
parameters.parameter_family: market-value percentile/tier-gap signal, roster-specific lineup replacement drop, and any incremental scarcity premium
parameters.source: FantasyCalc dynasty values for descriptive market tier; current roster and legal-lineup reoptimization for replacement sensitivity
parameters.validation: Market-tier signal may remain descriptive, but any incremental price/utility effect requires residual held-out evidence beyond the external market anchor. Roster replacement sensitivity is directly recomputed from the current legal roster.
parameters.uncertainty: Market prices already embed positional scarcity, so reusing their percentile/tier gaps as another positive premium risks double counting. Replacement sensitivity is current-roster evidence, not an injury probability or long-run WAR estimate.
parameters.update_policy: Keep market-tier scarcity diagnostic-only unless incremental validation succeeds; preserve roster-specific replacement calculations and improve them with observed lineup/availability evidence when useful.
parameters.notes: Structural de-duplication removes market-tier scarcity from incremental GM premiums and blend channels without altering projection means or uncertainty.

parameters.component: Strategic valuation adjustments inherited by GM 3.0
parameters.parameter_family: need, preference, window, endowment, starter/depth, performance, usage, injury and utility adjustments
parameters.validation: Required: family-by-family ablation and held-out prediction/decision testing
parameters.uncertainty: unknown incremental value; correlated inputs may double count
parameters.update_policy: Shrink/remove families lacking incremental validation; recalibrate surviving families from versioned evidence

parameters.parameter_family: 30-day external market trend layered onto current external dynasty market value
parameters.source: FantasyCalc current dynasty value plus FantasyCalc 30-day trend signal
parameters.validation: Required: time-ordered residual test showing that the trend adjustment improves future FSFFL-relevant value or decision accuracy beyond the current market anchor alone
parameters.uncertainty: current market value may already incorporate the information that created the recent price move
parameters.update_policy: Retain only if incremental held-out value over the current market anchor is demonstrated; otherwise remove the second market-on-market adjustment

parameters.parameter_family: future discount, tier multipliers, pick-slot scenarios, uncertainty growth and own-pick control
parameters.source: Current external dynasty pick anchors plus hard-coded GM 3.0 pick economics and scenario formulas
parameters.validation: Required: temporally comparable FSFFL rookie-draft outcomes and contemporaneous dynasty-market backtest; separate expected-player-value uncertainty from market/optionality pricing
parameters.uncertainty: material for future-heavy trades; future horizon currently does not independently broaden tier uncertainty while uncertainty can raise optionality
parameters.update_policy: Annual versioned recalibration after rookie-draft and season outcomes; promote only on holdout improvement

parameters.parameter_family: effective value weights for second/third assets, roster-slot drag, replacement relief and consolidation effects
parameters.source: Current hard-coded package weights and portfolio adjustments
parameters.validation: Required: estimate residual package economics from FSFFL completed trades with frozen contemporaneous value snapshots; broader dynasty transaction evidence is fallback only and must validate mapping
parameters.uncertainty: high leverage in 2-for-1 and 3-for-1 deals; completed trade geometry alone cannot identify the discount
parameters.update_policy: Version and refit as transaction/value-snapshot sample grows; promotion requires held-out transaction fit improvement

parameters.validation: Required: compare heuristic cut choice to exhaustive/top-k post-cut roster optimization
parameters.uncertainty: can change simulated roster and verdict when a trade forces cuts
parameters.update_policy: Prefer exact/top-k resolution where computationally feasible; recalibrate only if heuristic remains necessary

parameters.parameter_family: pair insurance, capture scale, portfolio adjustment and acceptance-fit shift
parameters.validation: Required: historical lineup-availability and/or simulated replacement-outcome estimation
parameters.update_policy: Retain as qualified functionality while bounded; replace with versioned empirical estimates when validated

parameters.parameter_family: source weights, smoothing, positional preference blend, residual scaling and confidence curve
parameters.source: Observed manager actions and leave-one-manager-out context transformed by hand-set blend weights/caps
parameters.validation: Required: time-ordered held-out manager-action prediction versus simple baselines plus family ablations
parameters.uncertainty: manager samples are sparse/non-stationary; structural leakage tests do not establish predictive validity
parameters.update_policy: Re-estimate on new manager actions with recency-aware validation; only promote if held-out ranking/log-loss improves

parameters.parameter_family: state-specific title/value floors, fit-score coefficients, HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW bands and behavioral/roster-fit shifts
parameters.source: Current hand-set bilateral-rationality and acceptance-fit thresholds; explicitly not a calibrated acceptance probability
parameters.validation: Required: sensitivity of Top-5/action decisions plus time-ordered prediction on a defensible accepted/rejected or choice-opportunity target
parameters.uncertainty: high leverage because heuristic bands gate realistic Top-5 inclusion and recommended negotiation action
parameters.update_policy: Preserve as qualified bilateral-plausibility functionality; calibrate only when a valid denominator/choice target exists and promote only on held-out improvement

parameters.parameter_family: package limits, plausibility thresholds, value-ratio bands, protected-asset penalties, need bonuses and top-N pools
parameters.validation: Required: recall against exhaustive search on tractable historical/test universes
parameters.uncertainty: false negatives can be invisible downstream
parameters.update_policy: Tune for high recall first; version thresholds and require recall non-regression

parameters.parameter_family: championship-probability and value thresholds for accept/lean/reject
parameters.source: Current fixed decision thresholds in the legacy Decision Lab path
parameters.validation: Required: simulation-error-aware calibration and historical decision/outcome testing
parameters.uncertainty: threshold width may be smaller than simulation/model uncertainty; production trade report uses the newer market-sweep chain
parameters.update_policy: Do not promote legacy bands; prefer canonical confidence-aware utility shared across production decision modules

parameters.parameter_family: state weights, diminishing returns and guardrails
parameters.validation: Required: historical recommendation ranking backtest and parameter-stability analysis
parameters.uncertainty: composite ordering may be sensitive despite correct raw simulations
parameters.update_policy: Move toward canonical calibrated utility shared across decision modules

parameters.parameter_family: current utility, dynasty, break-glass, liquidity, strategic composite, optionality, plausibility and competitive-externality multipliers
parameters.source: Current hard-coded state-aware post-simulation utility function
parameters.validation: Required: canonical utility calibration, historical ranking backtest, coefficient sensitivity, and explicit ablation of strategic/dynasty/break-glass/liquidity overlap
parameters.uncertainty: high leverage; strategic_value_delta is a GM composite that reuses value families also represented separately in the final score
parameters.update_policy: Replace with versioned canonical utility only after validation; expose raw tradeoffs and sensitivity in the meantime

parameters.parameter_family: counterfactual branch probabilities and decision policies
parameters.source: Known historical facts plus model-generated counterfactual decisions
parameters.validation: Validate factual inputs, no-hindsight information firewall, deterministic mechanics, sensitivity and probability calibration where observable; unknowable branches remain explicitly modeled inference
parameters.update_policy: Preserve functionality; improve evidence and calibration as historical analogues/data expand; never relabel modeled branches as historical fact
